instruction: Candid corporate photograph, medium shot. In a bright attic office, a woman in a houndstooth blazer (R4) stands in the center and shakes hands with a clean-shaven man in a black suit (R2) standing on the right. To the left, a bearded man in a black suit (R3) stands watching the interaction, while a bearded man with glasses and a striped tie (R1) stands in the background, smiling warmly. Natural light streams from a large skylight, highlighting the professional setting.
